fixtures.name: esm
fixtures.reason: v1.1 supports local ESM entry and dynamic import probes, but does not claim loader hooks, import maps, unrestricted network imports, or full desktop ESM behavior.

fixtures.name: process-permission
fixtures.reason: AutoJs6 exposes a read-only capability-query facade instead of desktop Node's permission model.

fixtures.name: async-local-storage
fixtures.reason: The supported AsyncLocalStorage propagation probe should match desktop Node.

fixtures.name: perf-hooks
fixtures.reason: AutoJs6 exposes safe timing, mark/measure, observer, and event-loop utilization probes without the full desktop perf_hooks surface.

fixtures.name: diagnostics-channel
fixtures.reason: The channel subscribe/publish/unsubscribe probe should match desktop Node.

fixtures.name: node-test
fixtures.reason: AutoJs6 keeps the embedded TAP subset and intentionally omits runner/reporting/mocking surfaces.

fixtures.name: timers-promises
fixtures.reason: The supported promise timer and AbortSignal probe should match desktop Node.

fixtures.name: stream-promises
fixtures.reason: The supported pipeline and finished probe should match desktop Node.

fixtures.name: webcrypto
fixtures.reason: AutoJs6 supports random values, UUID, digest, and HMAC while keeping asymmetric and derive surfaces absent.

fixtures.name: database
fixtures.reason: AutoJs6 exposes a controlled database/sqlite bridge and keeps desktop node:sqlite unavailable inside the Safe Node Profile.
